value.rationale: The ordinary matching complex of the canonical Petersen graph gives a natural mixed-dimensional example with *different* degree-two and degree-three S5 module structures: one reducible sign-twisted permutation module and one irreducible Specht module. Its full symmetry grading is not inferred from matching orbit numbers or ordinary Betti dimensions and supplies a meaningful input to equivariant graph-complex studies.
